Sandcastle handles sandboxing the agent with a configurable branch strategy.
The commits made on the branches get merged back.
Bind-mount when the sandbox can mount a host directory. Isolated when it has its own filesystem.
Sandcastle uses a SandboxProvider to create isolated environments.
Sandcastle uses a branch strategy configured on the sandbox provider to control how the agent's changes relate to branches.
Sandcastle uses a flexible prompt system.
All per-repo sandbox configuration lives in .sandcastle/.
Sandcastle exports a programmatic run() function for use in scripts, CI pipelines, or custom tooling.
Scaffolds the .sandcastle/ config directory and builds the container image.
Sandcastle ships with built-in providers for Docker, Podman, and Vercel, but you can create your own.
